commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Alvaro Morata (Como) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+1' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) picks up an injury.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Thomas Kristensen (Udinese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
87' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
86' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Ivan Smolcic and he is replaced by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como).
86' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue will be replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
86' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Christian Kabasele.
85' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Fabio Maresca ignores the protests.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
84' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
83' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
80' Substitution. Alvaro Morata (Como) replaces Assane Diao.
80' Assane Diao (Como) commits a foul during an attacking move.
79' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Maduka Okoye easily deals with the threat.
79' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is caught offside!
78' The foul by Ivan Smolcic (Como) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Fabio Maresca.
77' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Jean Butez, who makes a comfortable save.
74' Sergi Roberto (Como) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches over the crossbar.
72' Today's referee Fabio Maresca rightly decides to book Diego Carlos (Como) for his harsh tackle.
72' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
72' Ivan Smolcic (Como) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
69' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Idrissa Gueye.
69' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juan Arizala (Udinese) replacing Hassane Kamara.
68' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
65' Lennon Miller (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jakub Piotrowski.
64' Martin Baturina (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
60' The substitution is prepared. Sergi Roberto (Como) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Maximo Perrone.
60' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Martin Baturina (Como) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
59' It is time for a substitution. Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is on for Anastasios Douvikas.

57' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the middle of the goal, but it lacks power and Jean Butez pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
57' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) works the corner short.
56' A quickly taken corner by Udinese.
56' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Udinese force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
54' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Maduka Okoye.
54' Maxence Caqueret (Como) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Maximo Perrone (Como) attempts to discuss the decision with Fabio Maresca, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
48' The defensive wall jumps as one to block the free kick from Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese).
47' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Jean Butez has no trouble gathering it.

47' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Nico Paz (Como) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
45+1' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Jean Butez guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.
44' Arthur Atta (Udinese) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
42' Nico Paz (Como) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Maduka Okoye easily deals with the threat.
38' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
32' Como win a corner.
32' Assane Diao (Como) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' Arthur Atta (Udinese) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
29' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
26' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) jumps into a tackle and Fabio Maresca signals a foul.
23' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
21' A pass from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.
20' Arthur Atta (Udinese) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
18' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is penalised for a foul. Fabio Maresca had a clear view and blows his whistle.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Como.
15' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
11' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the top right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
10' Maduka Okoye blocks Maximo Perrone (Como)'s effort from the edge of the box.
7' A cross into the box picks out Diego Carlos (Como), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
7' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

6' Nico Paz (Como) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Como will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Maximo Perrone (Como) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Fabio Maresca.
